name: aura_work_stamping
description: Lots stamp work = max(work, LotBaseAura) over their inclusive rectangles: A (-4) and B (3) overlap at (2, 2) -> 3; a lot without a building stamps -128 (no change); cells outside every lot stay -128 through every later stage (crime fill 0 adds curve(0) = 10 only to lot cells: -4 -> 6, 3 -> 13), and base tract (0, 0) is trunc(average of its 12 valid cells) (old -128 -> the average). The time slice of 6.5: each iteration adds step to a counter and the clock is read only when the counter is a multiple of 1024; at the end of every call n = counter >> 10 and 1 <= n < 5 lowers the miss counter (at -4: reset, step doubles). With step 512, miss -1 and a timer that has expired: iteration 1 (512) takes a lot, iteration 2 (1024) reads the expired clock and stops -> one lot per call, n = 1 each time (miss -2, -3, then -4 -> step 1024, miss 0). With step 1024 the clock is read before every lot, so the expired timer stops the next call before its first lot (state stays 5, n = 1 -> miss -1); with the clock running, the next call reads it (1024), finds the end -> state 6, n = 1 -> miss -2. A later cycle with the clock running does the 3 lots and the end in 4 iterations: counter 4096, n = 4 -> miss -3. Hand-derived from 6.5.
